items.name: Cooler Master PCIe 4.0 x16 riser cable 200 mm
items.description: Exact 200 mm PCIe 4.0 x16 riser cable connecting the standard Mini-ITX x16 slot to the rear dual-slot GPU position; no printed riser clamp or receiver support is used.

items.name: 15 x 10 x 4 mm rectangular countersunk magnets
items.description: Center-screw rectangular magnets for twelve front, left and right corner-post stations; the screw-fixed rear panel uses no magnets.
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify actual countersink diameter, polarity and coating before ordering.
items.supply_risk: Commercial magnet countersink geometry varies; CAD uses an M3 center-screw interface and must be checked against the purchased magnet drawing.
items.selection_reason: Active receipts e1e78e24-2f91-428a-a0c1-91238622ebcc and 43d30133-9e3f-457c-a8a9-5e5ea8153d46 specify 15 x 10 x 4 mm and center-screw mounting.

items.name: M3 x 8 countersunk screw
items.description: One center screw per front, left and right corner-post magnet station.
items.selection_reason: Fits the M3 countersunk magnet interface and 4 mm magnet plus printed-post engagement stack.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 8 socket-head screw
items.description: Four screws fasten the top cap to the columns and four fasten the rear panel to the rear columns.
items.selection_reason: Matches the revision 50 kit-owned top-cap and screw-fixed rear-panel interfaces; no heat-set insert is modeled.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 4 socket-head screw
items.description: Four short screws fasten the Mini-ITX board to the uniform 4 mm-deep printed arms and two retain the standard dual-slot GPU bracket.
items.selection_reason: Revision 50 uses 1.6 mm motherboard thickness plus 2.4 mm light-duty self-forming engagement, resolving exactly to M3x4; the 1.5 mm GPU bracket interface also resolves to M3x4.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 12 socket-head screw
items.selection_reason: Passes through each 4 mm foot and the 3 mm base, then engages its separate printed column.

items.name: 12 mm panel-mount momentary power button
items.description: Normally-open momentary switch for the motherboard power header; front-panel opening is 12.2 mm diameter.
items.supply_risk: Thread length and rear terminal envelope must fit the 2.4 mm panel and internal cable path.
items.selection_reason: Matches the confirmed power-button-only front interface.
